rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Hekkova provides a permanent memory layer for AI agents, enabling them to mint moments (media or text) as ERC-721 NFTs on the Polygon blockchain. Content is stored on IPFS via Pinata, encrypted using Lit Protocol based on configurable privacy phases (New Moon for owner-only, Crescent for close circles, Gibbous for extended groups, and Full Moon for public access), and minted as immutable blockchain records. Users can retrieve, update privacy settings, and export their moments through a set of MCP tools, with advanced features like Eclipse time-locked moments available on the Legacy Plan.
